scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns direct maps \(P_{p,q}\to\mathfrak C_n\) and does not classify maps after subdivision of the source.
No claim is made about the complete Stong core or higher homotopy type of the mapping space.
The exact formula and null-homotopy statement require \(n\ge3\); the four-point crown \(\mathfrak C_2\) is an explicit sharp boundary.
title: Exact count and direct null-homotopy for complete height-two maps into longer crowns
